claims.claim: Added offline conformance tests composing existing Brain Sync, Unified State, Brain Work Context and Flow Resolver surfaces, with assertions for exact TASK/RUN lineage, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REVIEWER authority, repository-owned Flow Card and absence of execution, verification or mutation effects.

The tests assert that doorbells and arbitrary text cannot override canonical semantic selection, authority or next_action, and cover rejection of unsupported payload fields, stale bindings, altered lineage, missing subjects and ambiguous selection without chat fallback.

The tests constrain reconstruction to a bounded selected-subject read set, assert fingerprint invalidation after main, lifecycle, RUN or request movement, and check exclusion of remote URLs, credentials, raw-log pointers, chat history and provider/session metadata.

The committed delta contains only the two authorized conformance files and adds no production Python or workflow change, semantic router, lifecycle reducer, persistent reasoning store, assistant-output scraper, ChatGPT Work wake dependency or mutation authority.

The document defines a bounded live procedure for one real unresolved checkpoint reaching the bound regular Chat, requiring fresh canonical reconstruction, unresolved-subject checks, the existing Flow Card, at most one Reviewer continuation step, Human-boundary stops and a visible response in the same conversation.

The document preserves all six H4A5 residual live-evidence gaps and reopen triggers, states that deterministic TASK acceptance does not prove the future live Chat step, and reserves H4B closure and H5 start for separate Human/Brain planning actions.
